title: Affine-Subspace Trails for Full Alzette Instances
summary: A randomized search found no nontrivial affine-subspace trail for full Sparkle Alzette instances, while two-round reductions have trails of dimensions 56 through 63; whether such trails exist remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For each full Alzette instance $A_{c_i}$ using a round constant from Sparkle, determine whether there exists a nontrivial affine subspace that $A_{c_i}$ maps to a possibly different affine subspace of the same dimension: either construct such an affine-subspace trail or prove that none exists. A randomized to-and-fro search found no such trail, but it does not constitute a proof; the same method found trails of dimensions $56$ through $63$ for every two-round reduced ARX-box.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of full Alzette ARX-box instances using Sparkle round constants.
parameters: Sparkle round constant c_i, selecting an Alzette instance
Affine-subspace dimension, required to be nontrivial and preserved under the mapping

progress.summary: The source presents a randomized to-and-fro search over the Sparkle round constants and reports no nontrivial same-dimension affine-subspace trail for full Alzette instances. It explicitly says this is not a proof, while the same method found trails of dimensions 56 through 63 for every two-round reduced ARX-box.
